topic.angle: How far the farthest spacecraft is measured in light-time

card.title: Voyager 1 is nearly a light-day away

body.claim: Voyager 1 is about to be one light-day from Earth, farther than any other human-made object.
body.why: A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours. Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in August 2012 and is expected to reach one light-day away in November 2026.

probes.question: How many hours of light travel make one light-day?
True or false: Voyager 1 launched in 1977.

image_brief.show: An artist's concept or NASA image of the Voyager spacecraft

claims.claim: Voyager 1 is on the brink of reaching one light-day from Earth (title "nearly", claim "about to be")
claims.quote: Voyager 1 is on the brink of another unprecedented milestone - reaching a distance one light-day away from Earth.
claims.note: Time-sensitive. NASA page (last updated 2026-10-15) shows a countdown to NOV 18, 2026 and says "on the brink", so "nearly/about to be" is correct as of 2026-10-25 (about 24 days before). After 2026-11-18 the wording becomes stale and should be changed to past tense.

claims.claim: Voyager 1 is expected to reach one light-day away in November 2026
claims.quote: is expected to reach a distance of one light-day around November 2026

claims.claim: Voyager 1 is farther than any other human-made object
claims.quote: No spacecraft has gone farther than NASA's Voyager 1.

claims.claim: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 entered interstellar space in August 2012
claims.quote: Launched in 1977 to fly by Jupiter and Saturn, Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space in August 2012

claims.claim: A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours; one light-day = 24 hours of light travel (probe p1 answer 24)
